title: Fabrication of self-assembled CuO nanosheets for the sustainable synthesis of 2-substituted 1,3-benzothiazoles
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13135-13146
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01164K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Praveen Kumar Atal, Bhaskar Dwivedi, Diksha Bhardwaj, Debanjan Guin, Deepika Choudhary
Self-assembled, highly crystalline CuO nanosheets were fabricated and characterized. They showed excellent catalytic activity for the ultrasonication-assisted synthesis of 2-substituted 1,3-benzothiazoles.
